title: [BUILD][AYUMI] Sprint E: staged 17x5 tournament matrix on frozen window + FTMO verdict memo (direct node path)
tier_rationale: Card is sp 3.0 and decomposes per gate (G3 parity / G4 matrix / G5 stats / G6 verdict). The build itself is an EXECUTION + INGEST task, not a novel-module task: no new library code was written. Deliverables are the grid, the verdict memo, and two defect write-ups. The only code-adjacent finding is a one-line wiring defect that is DOCUMENTED here, not fixed here (fixing it would invalidate the whole staged matrix and force a full re-run, which is out of this card's scope). Targeted tests are required because the ingest tool is exercised against real scorecards.

in_scope: data/tournament/equivalence/WITHDRAWN.md (withdrawal marker; dir is gitignored so this is on-disk)
out_of_scope: scripts/run_tournament.py (cost_model wiring defect DOCUMENTED, deliberately NOT fixed here - a fix invalidates the entire staged matrix and forces a full re-run; belongs to a follow-on card)
src/tournament/harness.py (correct as-is; the defect is at the CLI layer)
The M3 timeframe cells (still running detached on the node; judged by scorecard files, not log tails)
The full 17x5 promotion (declined pre-launch on measured cost, NOT on results)
data/tournament/sprintE/ scorecards (produced by the node run, not authored here)

edge_cases: STANDING RULE 1: every node exec MUST pass BOTH host="node" and node="ava-worker-local" - node= alone is a silent gateway fallback. Applies to every exec in this build, including verification reads.

STANDING RULE 2: identity probe BEFORE trusting any node-attributed result. Hard-fail if machine-id matches the gateway baseline. Verified: node=cca4670d1810478e8248a31b17d06745, gateway=5b247455916a4330ad41e7489c955029. The 'Node:' header must be present; its absence is the fallback signature.

STANDING RULE 5: the resume brief asserted sprintE scorecards are fallback-era artifacts produced on xeon. Evidence CONTRADICTS this: gateway has no data/tournament/sprintE/ at all, 8 live processes are node-resident, node load 8.05 on 8 cores. Verified rather than assumed. Recorded as corrected-by-evidence.

Path existence is NOT residency evidence: the gateway also has an unrelated stale /opt/ayumi-tournament/ayumi dated Oct 4 that is not a git repo. Residency must be proven from processes/load, never from directory presence.
T6 must NEVER be silently waived. The ingest tool must refuse to emit GO without T6; verified it returns NO-GO with T6_state=UNEVALUABLE rather than degrading T6 to a pass.

cost_modeled=false on every row must NOT be read as 'costs were zero'. It means costs were NEVER APPLIED. Direction of bias: costs only subtract, so cost-free returns are an UPPER BOUND - sound for NO-GO, unsound for GO.
Partial ingest is legitimate ONLY if labelled incomplete. N=12 of 20 must be stated everywhere; M3 cells are missing because processes are still running, NOT because they were skipped.
Zero-signal triage must distinguish 'cell produced no signals' from 'cell has not finished'. No cell here was zero-signal; M3 is simply unfinished.
workboard_comment body must stay under 3900 chars; split into ordinal parts rather than truncating evidence.
Claim fence: sibling card 4a207c74 held a live claim; all claim-independent work was done BEFORE attempting workboard_claim.
test_plan: HR5 SCOPED ONLY - no full suite, ever, under any flag.
Run the committed ingest tool against the real node scorecards and confirm it exits 0 and self-reports the incompleteness: 'cells=12/20 complete=False tfs=[M5,M15,M30,H1]'.
Assert the emitted verdict is NO-GO and that T6_state is UNEVALUABLE (the tool must refuse to emit GO without T6).
Assert candidates_T4_pass == [] - no strategy clears T1-T5, which is what makes the NO-GO independent of T6.
Assert all 12 ingested rows carry cost_modeled == false, so the cost defect is captured in the evidence rather than only in prose.
Confirm the grid markdown renders all 12 cells including losers (card requires publishing losers).
No new code was written, so no new unit tests are required. The existing tournament suite is untouched and was NOT run (out of scope for a docs+ingest build).
api_verification: TournamentHarness.cost_model defaults to None at src/tournament/harness.py:944 - verified by direct source read.
scripts/run_tournament.py:211 constructs TournamentHarness(...) with no cost_model= argument - verified by grep; grep -c 'cost_model|COST_MODEL|spread' on that file returns 0.
harness.py:526-535 sets cost_fraction=None / cost_modeled=False for every trade when cost_model is None - verified by source read.

harness.py:868 cost_model_for(symbol) exists, reads the single sourced Liora table, and returns None for unknown symbols by design - verified by source read. Nothing in the run_tournament.py path calls it.
scorecard.py:298-299 derives row cost_modeled as bool(trades) and all(trades cost_modeled) - verified by source read.
ingest_and_verdict.py CLI surface verified by reading its argparse: --dir, --staged, --returns, --out, --grid-out.
risk: HIGHEST: reporting a grid without disclosing cost_modeled=false would overstate results. Mitigated - the cost warning is on the grid itself, in the memo, and in a dedicated defect write-up.

HIGH: citing the sprintE scorecards without provenance would let a fallback artifact be treated as node evidence. Mitigated - residency proven from processes/load, and the contradicting premise is recorded as corrected.
HIGH: quoting a cross-machine parity claim. Mitigated - G3 is marked WITHDRAWN with a marker file, and the memo explicitly declines to claim cross-machine evidence.
MEDIUM: treating N=12 as a complete 4x5 grid. Mitigated - completeness=false and expected_cells=20 are carried in the payload and stated in memo section 4.
MEDIUM: silently waiving T6 to reach a cleaner verdict. Mitigated - T6 reported UNEVALUABLE, not waived, and the NO-GO is shown to be independent of it.

MEDIUM: the two standing rules (cross-machine parity required vs compute never on xeon) are in direct tension. This is an authority conflict, NOT resolved here - escalated to Ava rather than papered over.
LOW: orphan node processes. M3 cells intentionally continue detached; they survive session end and are judged by scorecard files, not log tails.
